Package org.apache.juneau.console.views

Class JobLogChecks

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.views.JobLogChecks
public final class JobLogChecks extends Object
The shared shape checks of a job-log declaration, used by the console's page-level job-log card and by a JobLogRegion, so the two cannot drift.

Every check throws an IllegalArgumentException whose message names the offending key relative to the job-log body (for example "submit.fields[0] type must be ..."); each caller prefixes its own context.

Since:
10.0.0

  • Method Details

    • submit

      public static void submit(Map<?,?> submit, JobLogChecks.Mode mode)
      Checks a submit object's keys, method, label, envelope, action, key URL and fields.

      The page card checks its own endpoint first (it has the console's same-origin rule); a region's endpoint and keyUrl are checked here as same-origin templates whose only token is {id}.

      Parameters:
      submit - The submit object.
      mode - Where the declaration lives.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If a rule is broken.

    • field

      public static void field(int i, Object f, JobLogChecks.Mode mode, boolean actionEnvelope)
      Checks one field.
      Parameters:
      i - The field's index, for the message.
      f - The field.
      mode - Where the declaration lives; source needs a row, so the page card rejects it.
      actionEnvelope - Whether the fields are nested under fields (no reserved names) or flat.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If a rule is broken.
